properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 19 at 4:59PM MDT until October 19 at 5:45PM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:
SVREPZ

The National Weather Service in El Paso has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southern Grant County in southwestern New Mexico...
Central Hidalgo County in southwestern New Mexico...

* Until 545 PM MDT.

* At 458 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 4 miles east of
Animas, moving east at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect
wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Hachita, Animas, Playas, Windmill, and Hachita Valley.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

overnight temperatures falling into the upper 30s to low 40s. This

tender plants from the cold.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 19 at 3:50PM MST until October 19 at 4:15PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
At 350 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located 11 miles north of
Bowie, moving east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Mainly rural areas of North Central Cochise and Southeastern Graham
Counties.

This includes Interstate 10 near mile marker 357.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning is one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can
hear thunder, you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

Report severe weather to your nearest law enforcement agency or the
National Weather Service office in Tucson.
